statements.status_notes: The advisory marks paste unmaintained and declares no vulnerability. It is a compile-time proc macro reached through lofty, pulp, rav1e and metal; nothing it expands runs at runtime beyond what those crates already do.

The vulnerable path is BytesStart::attributes() and NsReader. The only 0.30.0 consumer is xcb, which uses it as a build dependency to parse the XML protocol files shipped inside that crate at compile time. Nothing attacker-controlled reaches it. The runtime copy (0.41.0 via wayland-scanner) is already patched.
Requires NsReader, which nothing in the tree instantiates: xcb's build-time reader over bundled XML is the only 0.30.0 consumer and wayland-scanner uses the patched 0.41.0.
